gameDescriptionHtml: The Sexy Brutale is a Murder-Mystery Adventure developed by Cavalier Game Studios and Tequila Works. Inside The Sexy Brutale casino mansion is a never-ending masked ball featuring intrigue, murder and the (quite possibly) occult.
